faqs.question: How do I book a package?
faqs.answer: You can book directly through our website or call our 24/7 support team. We accept all major payment methods and offer flexible payment plans.

faqs.question: What's included in the packages?
faqs.answer: Our packages typically include accommodation, meals, transportation, guided tours, and travel insurance. Specific inclusions vary by package.

faqs.question: Can I customize my trip?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We offer fully customizable packages to match your preferences, budget, and travel dates.

faqs.question: What's your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: We offer flexible cancellation up to 48 hours before departure for most packages. Premium packages may have different terms.

faqs.question: Do you provide travel insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes, comprehensive travel insurance is included in all our packages, covering medical emergencies, trip cancellation, and lost baggage.

faqs.question: How do I contact support while traveling?
faqs.answer: Our 24/7 support team is available via phone, WhatsApp, or our mobile app. We also have local representatives in most destinations.
